title: Highly recommended
text:
Thank to Esther, our very competent, friendly and varm guide ❤️ 
Lucky us who had our own private guide to show us the hidden gems of Alhambra by night!! 
We are so grateful for Esther. She knows Alhambra by heart, and told us about all the hidden details  as well. This night we will remember always ❤️ Highly recommended!
author: cilla1966
